entries.1: אב 'âb awb A primitive word; father in a literal and {immediate} or figurative and remote application: - {chief} (fore-) father ({[-less]}) X {patrimony} principal. Compare names in "Abi-"
entries.2: אב 'ab ab (Chaldee); corresponding to H1: - father.
entries.3: אב 'êb abe From the same as H24; a green plant: - {greenness} fruit.
entries.4: אב 'êb abe (Chaldee); corresponding to H3: - fruit.
entries.5: אבגתא 'ăbagthâ' ab-ag-thaw' Of foreign origin; {Abagtha} a eunuch of Xerxes: - Abagtha.
entries.6: אבד 'âbad aw-bad' A primitive root; properly to wander {away} that is lose oneself; by implication to perish ({causatively} destroy): - {break} destroy ({-uction}) + not {escape} {fail} {lose} (cause {to} make) {perish} {spend} X and {surely} {take} be {undone} X {utterly} be void {of} have no way to flee.
entries.7: אבד 'ăbad ab-ad' (Chaldee); corresponding to H6: - {destroy} perish.
entries.8: אבד 'ôbêd o-bade' Active participle of H6; (concretely) wretched or (abstractly) destruction: - perish.
entries.9: אבדה 'ăbêdâh ab-ay-daw' From H6; concretely something lost; abstractly {destruction} that is Hades: - lost. Compare H10.
entries.10: אבדּה 'ăbaddôh ab-ad-do' The same as {H9} miswritten for H11; a perishing: - destruction.
entries.11: אבדּון 'ăbaddôn ab-ad-done' Intensively from H6; abstractly a perishing; concretely Hades: - destruction.
entries.12: אבדן 'abdân ab-dawn' From H6; a perishing: - destruction.
entries.13: אבדן 'obdân ob-dawn' From H6; a perishing: - destruction.
entries.14: אבה 'âbâh aw-baw' A primitive root; to breathe {after} that is (figuratively) to be acquiescent: - {consent} rest {content} {will} be willing.
entries.15: אבה 'âbeh aw-beh' From H14; longing: - desire.
entries.16: אבה 'êbeh ay-beh' From H14 (in the sense of bending towards); the papyrus: - swift.
entries.17: אבוי 'ăbôy ab-o'ee From H14 (in the sense of desiring); want: - sorrow.
entries.18: אבוּס 'êbûs ay-booce' From H75; a manger or stall: - crib.
entries.19: אבחה 'ibchâh ib-khaw' From an unused root (apparently meaning to turn); brandishing of a sword: - point.
entries.20: אבטּיח 'ăbaţţîyach ab-at-tee'-akh Of uncertain derivation; a melon (only plural): - melon.
entries.21: אבי 'ăbîy ab-ee' From H1; fatherly; {Abi} Hezekiah´ s mother: - Abi.
entries.22: אביאל 'ăbîy'êl ab-ee-ale' From H1 and H410; father (that is possessor) of God; {Abiel} the name of two Israelites: - Abiel.
entries.23: אביאסף 'ăbîy'âsâph ab-ee-aw-sawf' From H1 and H622; father of gathering (that is gatherer); {Abiasaph} an Israelite: - Abiasaph.
entries.24: אביב 'âbîyb aw-beeb' From an unused root (meaning to be tender); {green} that is a young ear of grain; hence the name of the month Abib or Nisan: - {Abib} {ear} green ears of corn.
entries.25: אבי גבעון 'ăbîy gib‛ôn ab-ee' ghib-one' From H1 and H1391; father (that is founder) of Gibon; {Abi-Gibon} perhaps an Israelite: - father of Gibeon.
entries.26: אביגל אביגיל 'ăbîygayil 'ăbîygal {ab-ee-gah'yil} ab-ee-gal' From H1 and H1524; father (that is source) of joy; Abigail or {Abigal} the name of two Israelitesses: - Abigal.
entries.27: אבידן 'ăbîydân ab-ee-dawn' From H1 and H1777; father of judgment (that is judge); {Abidan} an Israelite: - Abidan.
entries.28: אבידע 'ăbîydâ‛ ab-ee-daw' From H1 and H3045; father of knowledge (that is knowing); {Abida} a son of Abraham by Keturah: - {Abida} Abidah.
entries.29: אביּהוּ אביּה 'ăbîyâh 'ăbîyâhû {ab-ee-yaw'} ab-ee-yaw'-hoo From H1 and H3050; father (that is worshipper) of Jah; {Abijah} the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses: - {Abiah} Abijah.
entries.30: אביהוּא 'ăbîyhû' ab-ee-hoo' From H1 and H1931; father (that is worshipper) of Him (that is God); {Abihu} a son of Aaron: - Abihu.
entries.31: אביהוּד 'ăbîyhûd ab-ee-hood' From H1 and H1935; father (that {is} possessor) of renown; {Abihud} the name of two Israelites: - Abihud.
entries.32: אביחיל אביהיל 'ăbîyhayil 'ăbîychayil {ab-ee-hah'-yil} ab-ee-khah'-yil (More correct in its second form); from H1 and H2428; father (that {is} possessor) of might; Abihail or {Abichail} the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses: - Abihail.
entries.33: אבי העזרי 'ăbîy hâ‛ezrîy ab-ee'-haw-ez-ree' From H44 with the article inserted; father of the Ezrite; and Abiezrite or descendant of Abiezer: - Abiezrite.
entries.34: אביון 'ebyôn eb-yone' From {H14} in the sense of want (especially in feeling); destitute: - {beggar} {needy} poor (man).
entries.35: אביּונה 'ăbîyônâh ab-ee-yo-naw' From H14; provocative of desire; the caper berry (from its stimulative taste): - desire.
entries.36: אביטוּב 'ăbîyţûb ab-ee-toob' From H1 and H2898; father of goodness (that {is} good); {Abitub} an Israelite: - Abitub.
entries.37: אביטל 'ăbîyţal ab-ee-tal' From H1 and H2919; father of dew (that {is} fresh); {Abital} a wife of King David: - Abital.
entries.38: אביּם 'ăbîyâm ab-ee-yawm' From H1 and H3220; father of (the) sea (that {is} seaman); Abijam (or {Abijah}) a king of Judah: - Abijam.
entries.39: אבימאל 'ăbîymâ'êl ab-ee-maw-ale' From H1 and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; father of Mael (apparently some Arab tribe); {Abimael} a son of Joktan: - Abimael.
entries.40: אבימלך 'ăbîymelek ab-ee-mel'-ek From H1 and H4428; father of (the) king; {Abimelek} the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites: - Abimelech.
entries.41: אבינדב 'ăbîynâdâb ab-ee-naw-dawb' From H1 and H5068; father of generosity (that {is} liberal); {Abinadab} the name of four Israelites: - Abinadab.
entries.42: אבינעם 'ăbîynô‛am ab-ee-no'-am From H1 and H5278; father of pleasantness (that {is} gracious); {Abinoam} an Israelite: - Abinoam.
entries.43: אביסף 'ebyâsâph eb-yaw-sawf' Construction from H23; {Ebjasaph} an Israelite: - Ebiasaph.
entries.44: אביעזר 'ăbîy‛ezer ab-ee-ay'-zer From H1 and H5829; father of help (that {is} helpful); {Abiezer} the name of two Israelites: - Abiezer.
entries.45: אבי־עלבון 'ăbîy-‛albôn ab-ee al-bone' From H1 and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably father of strength (that {is} valiant); {Abialbon} an Israelite: - Abialbon.
entries.46: אביר 'âbîyr aw-beer' From H82; mighty (spoken of God): - mighty (one).
entries.47: אבּיר 'abbîyr ab-beer' For H46: - {angel} {bull} {chiefest} mighty ({one}) stout {[-hearted]} strong ({one}) valiant.
entries.48: אבירם 'ăbîyrâm ab-ee-rawm' From H1 and H7311; father of height (that {is} lofty); {Abiram} the name of two Israelites: - Abiram.
entries.49: אבישׁג 'ăbîyshag ab-ee-shag' From H1 and H7686; father of error (that {is} blundering); {Abishag} a concubine of David: - Abishag.
entries.50: אבישׁוּע 'ăbîyshûa‛ ab-ee-shoo'-ah From H1 and H7171; father of plenty (that {is} prosperous); {Abishua} the name of two Israelites: - Abishua.
entries.51: אבישׁוּר 'ăbîyshûr ab-ee-shoor' From H1 and H7791; father of (the) wall (that {is} perhaps {mason}) {Abishur} an Israelites: - Abishur.
entries.52: אבשׁי אבישׁי 'ăbîyshay 'abshay {ab-ee-shah'ee} ab-shah'ee From H1 and H7862; father of a gift (that {is} probably generous); {Abishai} an Israelite: - Abishai.
entries.53: אבשׁלום אבישׁלום 'ăbîyshâlôm 'abshâlôm {ab-ee-shaw-lome'} ab-shaw-lome' From H1 and H7965; father of peace (that {is} friendly); {Abshalom} a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite: - {Abishalom} Absalom.
entries.54: אביתר 'ebyâthâr eb-yaw-thawr' Contracted from H1 and H3498; father of abundance (that {is} liberal); {Ebjathar} an Israelite: - Abiathar.
entries.55: אבך 'âbak aw-bak' A primitive root; probably to coil upward: - mount up.
entries.56: אבל 'âbal aw-bal' A primitive root; to bewail: - {lament} mourn.
entries.57: אבל 'âbêl aw-bale' From H56; lamenting: - mourn ({er} -ing).
entries.58: אבל 'âbêl aw-bale' From an unused root (meaning to be grassy); a meadow: - plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-.
entries.59: אבל 'âbêl aw-bale' From H58; a meadow; {Abel} the name of two places in Palestine: - Abel.
entries.60: אבל 'êbel ay'-bel From H56; lamentation: - mourning.
entries.61: אבל 'ăbâl ab-awl' Apparently from H56 through the idea of negation; {nay} that {is} truly or yet: - {but} {indeed} {nevertheless} verily.
entries.62: אבל בּית־מעכה 'âbêl bêyth mă‛akâh aw-bale' bayth ma-a-kaw' From H58 and H1004 and H4601; meadow of Beth-Maakah; Abel of {Beth-Maakah} a place in Palestine: - {Abel-beth-maachah} Abel of Beth-maachah.
entries.63: אבל השּׁטּים 'âbêl hashshiţţîym aw-bale' hash-shit-teem' From H58 and the plural of {H7848} with the article inserted; meadow of the acacias; Abel {hash-Shittim} a place in Palestine: - Abel-shittim.
entries.64: אבל כּרמים 'âbêl kerâmîym aw-bale' ker-aw-meem' From H58 and the plural of H3754; meadow of vineyards; {Abel-Keramim} a place in Palestine: - plain of the vineyards.
entries.65: אבל מחולה 'âbêl mechôlâh aw-bale' mekh-o-law' From H58 and H4246; meadow of dancing; {Abel-Mecholah} a place in Palestine: - Abel-meholah.
entries.66: אבל מים 'abêl mayim aw-bale' mah'-yim From H58 and H4325; meadow of water; {Abel-Majim} a place in Palestine: - Abel-maim.
entries.67: אבל מצרים 'âbêl mitsrayim aw-bale' mits-rah'-yim From H58 and H4714; meadow of Egypt; {Abel-Mitsrajim} a place in Palestine: - Abel-mizraim.
entries.68: אבן 'eben eh'-ben From the root of H1129 through the {meaning} to build; a stone: - + {carbuncle} + {mason} + {plummet} {[chalk-} {hail-} {bead-} sling-] stone ({-ny}) (divers) weight (-s).
entries.69: אבן 'eben eh'-ben (Chaldee); corresponding to H68: - stone.
entries.70: אבן 'ôben o'-ben From the same as H68; a pair of stones (only dual); a potter´ s wheel or a midwife´ s stool (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between): - {wheel} stool.
entries.71: אבנה 'ăbânâh ab-aw-naw' Perhaps feminine of H68; stony; {Abanah} a river near Damascus: - Abana. Compare H549.
entries.72: אבן העזר 'eben hâ‛êzer eh'-ben haw-e'-zer From H68 and H5828 with the article inserted; stone of the help; Eben {ha-Ezer} a place in Palestine: - Ebenezer.
entries.73: אבנט 'abnêţ ab-nate' Of uncertain derivation; a belt: - girdle.
entries.74: אבינר אבנר 'abnêr 'ăbîynêr {ab-nare'} ab-ee-nare' From H1 and H5216; father of light (that {is} enlightening); {Abner} an Israelite: - Abner.
entries.75: אבס 'âbas aw-bas' A primitive root; to fodder: - {fatted} stalled.
entries.76: אבעבּעה 'ăba‛bû‛âh ab-ah-boo-aw' (By reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth); an inflammatory pustule (as eruption): - blains.
entries.77: אבץ 'ebets eh'-bets From an unused {root} probably means to gleam; conspicuous; {Ebets} a place in Palestine: - Abez.
entries.78: אבצן 'ibtsân ib-tsawn' From the same as H76; splendid; {Ibtsan} an Israelite: - Ibzan.
entries.79: אבק 'âbaq aw-bak' A primitive root; probably to float away (as {vapor}) but used only as denominative from H80; to {bedust} that {is} grapple: - wrestle.
entries.80: אבק 'âbâq aw-bawk' From root of H79; light particles (as volatile): - (small) {dust} powder.
entries.81: אבקה 'ăbâqâh ab-aw-kaw' Feminine of H80: - powder.
entries.82: אבר 'âbar aw-bar' A primitive root; to soar: - fly.
entries.83: אבר 'êber ay-ber' From H82; a pinion: - [long-] wing (-ed).
entries.84: אברה 'ebrâh eb-raw' Feminine of H83: - {feather} wing.
entries.85: אברהם 'abrâhâm ab-raw-hawm' Contracted from H1 and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous); father of a multitude; {Abraham} the later name of Abram: - Abraham.
entries.86: אברך 'abrêk ab-rake' Probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel: - bow the knee.
entries.87: אברם 'abrâm ab-rawm' Contracted from H48; high father; {Abram} the original name of Abraham: - Abram.
entries.88: אבת 'ôbôth o-both' Plural of H178; water skins; {oboth} a place in the Desert: - Oboth.
entries.89: אגא 'âgê' aw-gay' Of uncertain derivation (compare H90); {Age} an Israelite: - Agee.
entries.90: אגג 'ăgag ag-ag' Of uncertain derivation (compare H89); flame; {Agag} a title of Amalekitish kings: - Agag.
entries.91: אגגי 'ăgâgîy ag-aw-ghee' Patrial or patronymic from H90; an Agagite or descendant (subject) of Agag: - Agagite.
entries.92: אגדּה 'ăgûddâh ag-ood-daw' Feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to bind); a {band} bundle6 {knot} or arch: - {bunch} {burden} troop.
entries.93: אגוז 'ĕgôz eg-oze' Probably of Persian origin; a nut: - nut.
entries.94: אגוּר 'âgûr aw-goor' Passive participle of H103; gathered (that {is} received among the sages); {Agur} a fanciful name of Solomon: - Agur.
entries.95: אגורה 'ăgôrâh ag-o-raw' From the same as H94; properly something {gathered} that {is} perhaps a grain or berry; used only of a small (silver) coin: - piece [of] silver.
entries.96: אגל 'egel eh'-ghel From an unused root (meaning to flow down or together as drops); a reservoir: - drop.
entries.97: אגלים 'eglayim eg-lah'-yim Dual of H96; a double pond; {Eglajim} a place in Moab: - Eglaim.
entries.98: אגם 'ăgam ag-am' From an unused root (meaning to collect as water); a marsh; hence a rush (as growing in swamps); hence a stockade of reeds: - {pond} {pool} standing [water].
entries.99: אגם 'âgêm aw-game' Probably from the same as H98 (in the sense of stagnant water); figuratively sad: - pond.
entries.100: אגמון 'agmôn ag-mone' From the same as H98; a marshy pool (others from a different {root} a kettle); by implication a rush (as growing there); collectively a rope of rushes: - {bulrush} {caldron} {hook} rush.
entries.101: אגּן 'aggân ag-gawn' Probably from H5059; a bowl (as pounded out hollow): - {basin} {cup} goblet.
entries.102: אגּף 'aggâph ag-gawf' Probably from H5062 (through the idea of impending); a cover or heap; that {is} (only plural) wings of an {army} or crowds of troops: - bands.
entries.103: אגר 'âgar aw-gar' A primitive root; to harvest: - gather.
entries.104: אגּרא 'iggerâ' ig-er-aw' (Chaldee); of Persian origin; an epistle (as carried by a state courier or postman): - letter.
entries.105: אגרטל 'ăgarţâl ag-ar-tawl' Of uncertain derivation; a basin: - charger.
entries.106: אגרף 'egrôph eg-rofe' From H1640 (in the sense of grasping); the clenched hand: - fist.
entries.107: אגּרת 'iggereth ig-eh'-reth Feminine of H104; an epistle: - letter.
entries.108: אד 'êd ade From the same as H181 (in the sense of enveloping); a fog: - {mist} vapor.
entries.109: אדב 'âdab aw-dab' A primitive root; to languish: - grieve.
entries.110: אדבּאל 'adbe'êl ad-beh-ale' Probably from H109 (in the sense of chastisement) and H410; disciplined of God; {Adbeel} a son of Ishmael: - Adbeel.
entries.111: אדד 'ădad ad-ad' Probably an orthographical variation for H2301; Adad (or {Hadad}) an Edomite: - Hadad.
entries.112: אדּו 'iddô id-do Of uncertain derivation; {Iddo} an Israelite: - Iddo.
entries.113: אדן אדון 'âdôn 'âdôn {aw-done'} aw-done' From an unused root (meaning to rule); {sovereign} that {is} controller (human or divine): - {lord} {master} owner. Compare also names beginning with "Adoni-".
entries.114: אדּון 'addôn ad-done' Probably intensive for H113; powerful; {Addon} apparently an Israelite: - Addon.
entries.115: אדורים 'ădôrayim ad-o-rah'-yim Dual from H142 (in the sense of eminence); double mound; {Adorajim} a place in Palestine: - Adoraim.
entries.116: אדין 'ĕdayin ed-ah'-yin (Chaldee); of uncertain derivation; then (of time): - {now} that {time} then.
entries.117: אדּיר 'addîyr ad-deer' From H142; wide or (generally) large; figuratively powerful: - {excellent} {famous} {gallant} {glorious} {goodly} {lordly} mighty ({-ier} {one}) {noble} {principal} worthy.
entries.118: אדליא 'ădalyâ' ad-al-yaw' Of Persian derivation; {Adalja} a son of Haman: - Adalia.
entries.119: אדם 'âdam aw-dam' To show blood (in the {face}) that {is} flush or turn rosy: - be ({dyed} made) red (ruddy).
entries.120: אדם 'âdâm aw-dawm' From H119; {ruddy} that {is} a human being (an individual or the {species} {mankind} etc.): - X {another} + {hypocrite} + common {sort} X {low} man ({mean} of low {degree}) person.
entries.121: אדם 'âdâm aw-dawm' The same as H120; {Adam} the name of the first {man} also of a place in Palestine: - Adam.
entries.122: אדם 'âdôm aw-dome' From H119; rosy: - {red} ruddy.
entries.123: אדום אדם 'ĕdôm 'ĕdôm {ed-ome'} ed-ome' From H122; red (see Gen 25:25); {Edom} the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occuped by him: - {Edom} {Edomites} Idumea.
entries.124: אדם 'ôdem o'-dem From H119; {redness} that {is} the {ruby} {garnet} or some other red gem: - sardius.
entries.125: אדמדּם 'ădamdâm ad-am-dawm' Reduplicated from H119; reddish: - (somewhat) reddish.
entries.126: אדמה 'admâh ad-maw' Contracted for H127; earthy; {Admah} a place near the Dead Sea: - Admah.
entries.127: אדמה 'ădâmâh ad-aw-maw' From H119; soil (from its general redness): - {country} {earth} {ground} husband [-man] ({-ry}) land.
entries.128: אדמה 'ădâmâh ad-aw-maw' The same as H127; {Adamah} a place in Palestine: - Adamah.
entries.129: אדמי 'ădâmîy ad-aw-mee' From H127; earthy; {Adami} a place in Palestine: - Adami.
entries.130: אדמי 'ĕdômîy ed-o-mee' Patronymic from H123; an {Edomite} or descendant from (or inhabitant of) Edom: - Edomite. See H726.
entries.131: אדמּים 'ădûmmîym ad-oom-meem' Plural of H121; red spots; {Adummim} a pass in Palestine: - Adummim.
entries.132: אדמוני אדמני 'admônîy 'admônîy {ad-mo-nee'} ad-mo-nee' From H119; reddish (of the hair or the complexion): - {red} ruddy.
entries.133: אדמתא 'admâthâ' ad-maw-thaw' Probably of Persian derivation; {Admatha} a Persian nobleman: - Admatha.
entries.134: אדן 'eden eh'-den From the same as H113 (in the sense of strength); a basis (of a {building} a {column} etc.): - {foundation} socket.
entries.135: אדּן 'addân ad-dawn' Intensive from the same as H134; firm; {Addan} an Israelite: - Addan.
entries.136: אדני 'ădônây ad-o-noy' An emphatic form of H113; the Lord (used as a proper name of God only): - (my) Lord.
entries.137: אדני־בזק 'ădônîy-bezeq ad-o''-nee-beh'-zek From H113 and H966; lord of Bezek; {Adoni-Bezek} a Canaanitish king: - Adoni-bezek.
entries.138: אדניּהוּ אדניּה 'ădônîyâh 'ădônîyâhû {ad-o-nee-yaw'} ad-o-nee-yaw'-hoo From H113 and H3050; lord (that {is} worshipper) of Jah; {Adonijah} the name of three Israelites: - Adonijah.
entries.139: אדני־צדק 'ădônîy-tsedeq ad-o''-nee-tseh'-dek From H113 and H6664; lord of justice; {Adoni-Tsedek} a Canaanitish king: - Adonizedec.
entries.140: אדניקם 'ădônîyqâm ad-o-nee-kawm' From H113 and H6965; lord of rising (that {is} high); {Adonikam} the name of one or two Israelites: - Adonikam
entries.141: אדנירם 'ădônîyrâm ad-o-nee-rawm' From H113 and H7311; lord of height; {Adoniram} an Israelite: - Adoniram.
entries.142: אדר 'âdar aw-dar A primitive root; to {expand} that {is} be great or (figuratively) magnificent: - (become) {glorious} honourable.
entries.143: אדר 'ădâr ad-awr' Probably of foreign derivation; perhaps meaning fire; {Adar} the H12 th Hebrew month: - Adar.
entries.144: אדר 'ădâr ad-awr' (Chaldee); corresponding to H143: - Adar.
entries.145: אדר 'eder eh'-der From H142; {amplitude} that {is} (concretely) a mantle; also (figuratively) splendor: - {goodly} robe.
entries.146: אדּר 'addâr ad-dawr' Intensive from H142; ample; {Addar} a place in Palestine; also an Israelite: - Addar.
entries.147: אדּר 'iddar id-dar' (Chaldee); intensive from a root corresponding to H142; {ample} that {is} a threshing-floor: - threshingfloor.
entries.148: אדרגּזר 'ădargâzêr ad-ar''-gaw-zare' (Chaldee); from the same as {H147} and H1505; a chief {diviner} or astrologer: - judge.
entries.149: אדרזדּא 'adrazdâ' ad-raz-daw' (Chaldee); probably of Persian origin; quickly or carefully: - dilligently.
entries.150: אדרכּן 'ădarkôn ad-ar-kone' Of Persian origin; a daric or Persian coin: - dram.
entries.151: אדרם 'ădôrâm ad-o-rawm' Contracted for H141; Adoram (or {Adoniram}) an Israelite: - Adoram.
entries.152: אדרמּלך 'adrammelek ad-ram-meh'-lek From H142 and H4428; splendor of (the) king; {Adrammelek} the name of an Assyrian {idol} also of a son of Sennacherib: - Adrammelech.

entries.296: אחיקם 'ăchîyqâm akh-ee-kawm' From H251 and H6965; brother of rising (that {is} high); {Achikam} an Israelite: - Ahikam.
entries.297: אחירם 'ăchîyrâm akh-ee-rawm' From H251 and H7311; brother of height (that {is} high); {Achiram} an Israelite: - Ahiram.
entries.298: אחירמי 'ăchîyrâmîy akh-ee-raw-mee' Patronymic from H297; an Achiramite or descendants (collectively) of Achiram: - Ahiramites.
entries.299: אחירע 'ăchîyra‛ akh-ee-rah' From H251 and H7451; brother of wrong; {Achira} an Israelite: - Ahira.
entries.300: אחישׁחר 'ăchîyshachar akh-ee-shakh'-ar From H251 and H7837; brother of (the) dawn; {Achishachar} an Israelite: - Ahishar.
entries.301: אחישׁר 'ăchîyshâr akh-ee-shawr' From H251 and H7891; brother of (the) singer; {Achishar} an Israelite: - Ahishar.
entries.302: אחיתפל 'ăchîythôphel akh-ee-tho'-fel From H251 and H8602; brother of folly; {Achithophel} an Israelite: - Ahithophel.
entries.303: אחלב 'achlâb akh-lawb' From the same root as H2459; fatness (that {is} fertile); {Achlab} a place in Palestine: - Ahlab.
entries.304: אחלי 'achlay akh-lah'ee The same as H305; wishful; {Achlai} the name of an Israelitess and of an Israelite: - Ahlai.
entries.305: אחלי אחלי 'achălay 'achălêy {ak-al-ah'ee} akh-al-ay' Probably from H253 and a variation of H3863; would that!: - O {that} would God.
entries.306: אחלמה 'achlâmâh akh-law'-maw Perhaps from H2492 (and thus dream stone); a {gem} probably the amethyst: - amethyst.
entries.307: אחמתא 'achmethâ' akh-me-thaw' Of Persian derivation; Achmetha (that {is} {Ecbatana}) the summer capital of Persia: - Achmetha.
entries.308: אחסבּי 'ăchasbay akh-as-bah'ee Of uncertain derivation; {Achasbai} an Israelite: - Ahasbai.
entries.309: אחר 'âchar aw-khar' A primitive root; to loiter (that {is} be behind); by implication to procrastinate: - {continue} {defer} {delay} {hinder} be late ({slack}) stay ({there}) tarry (longer).
entries.310: אחר 'achar akh-ar' From H309; properly the hind part; generally used as an adverb or {conjugation} after (in various senses): - after ({that} {-ward}) {again} {at} away {from} back ({from} {-side}) {behind} {beside} {by} follow ({after} {-ing}) {forasmuch} {from} {hereafter} hinder {end} + out (over) {live} + {persecute} {posterity} {pursuing} {remnant} {seeing} {since} thence {[-forth]} {when} with.
entries.311: אחר 'achar akh-ar' (Chaldee); corresponding to H310; after: - [here-] after.
entries.312: אחר 'achêr akh-air' From H309; properly hinder; generally {next} {other} etc.: - (an-) other ({man}) {following} {next} strange.
entries.313: אחר 'achêr akh-air' The same as H312; {Acher} an Israelite: - Aher.
entries.314: אחרן אחרין 'achăryôn 'achărôn {akh-ar-one'} akh-ar-one' From H309; hinder; generally late or last; specifically (as facing the east) western: - after ({-ward}) to {come} {following} hind ({-er} {-ermost} {-most}) {last} {latter} {rereward} ut(ter)most.
entries.315: אחרח 'achrach akh-rakh From H310 and H251; after (his) brother; {Achrach} an Israelite: - Aharah.
entries.316: אחרחל 'ăcharchêl akh-ar-kale' From H310 and H2426; behind (the) intrenchment (that {is} safe); {Acharchel} an Israelite: - Aharhel.
entries.317: אחרי 'ochŏrîy okh-or-ee' (Chaldee); from H311; other: - (an-) other.
entries.318: אחרן אחרין 'ochŏrêyn 'ochŏrên {okh-or-ane'} okh-or-ane' (Chaldee); from H317; last: - at last.
entries.319: אחרית 'achărîyth akh-ar-eeth' From H310; the last or {end} hence the future; also posterity: - ({last} latter) end ({time}) hinder (utter) {-most} {length} {posterity} {remnant} {residue} reward.
entries.320: אחרית 'achărîyth akh-ar-eeth' (Chaldee); from H311; the same as H319; later: - latter.
entries.321: אחרן 'ochŏrân okh-or-awn' (Chaldee); from H311; the same as H317; other: - (an-) other.
entries.322: אחרנּית 'ăchôrannîyth akh-o-ran-neeth' Prolonged from H268; backwards: - {back(-ward} again).
entries.323: אחשׁדּרפּן 'ăchashdarpan akh-ash-dar-pan' Of Persian derivation; a satrap or governor of a main province (of Persia): - lieutenant.
entries.324: אחשׁדּרפּן 'ăchashdarpan akh-ash-dar-pan' (Chaldee); corresponding to H323: - prince.
entries.325: אחשׁרשׁ אחשׁורושׁ 'ăchashvêrôsh 'achashrôsh {akh-ash-vay-rosh'} akh-ash-rosh' Of Persian origin; Achashverosh (that {is} Ahasuerus or {Artaxerxes} but in this case {Xerxes}) the title (rather than name) of a Persian king: - Ahasuerus.
entries.326: אחשׁתּרי 'ăchashtârîy akh-ash-taw-ree' Probably of Persian derivation; an achastarite (that {is} courier); the designation (rather than name) of an Israelite: - Haakashtari [includ. the article.]
entries.327: אחשׁתּרן 'ăchashtârân akh-ash-taw-rawn' Of Persian origin; a mule: - camel.
entries.328: אט 'aţ at From an unused root perhaps meaning to move softly; (as a noun) a necromancer (from their soft {incantations}) (as an adverb) gently: - {charmer} {gently} {secret} softly.
entries.329: אטד 'âţâd aw-tawd From an unused root probably meaning to pierce or make fast; a thorn tree (especially the buckthorn): - {Atad} {bramble} thorn.
entries.330: אטוּן 'êţûn ay-toon' From an unused root (probably meaning to bind); properly twisted ({yarn}) that {is} tapestry: - fine linen.
entries.331: אטם 'âţam aw-tam' A primitive root; to close (the lips or ears); by analogy to contract (a window by bevelled jambs): - {narrow} {shut} stop.
entries.332: אטר 'âţar aw-tar' A primitive root; to close up: - shut.
entries.333: אטר 'âţêr aw-tare' From H332; maimed; {Ater} the name of three Israelites: - Ater.
entries.334: אטּר 'iţţêr it-tare From H332; shut {up} the {is} impeded (as to the use of the right hand): - + left-handed.
entries.335: אי 'ay ah'ee Perhaps from H370; where? hence how?: - {how} {what} {whence} {where} {whether} which (way).
entries.336: אי 'îy ee Probably identical with H335 (through the idea of a query); not. (Job 22:30): - island (Job H22 : H30).
entries.337: אי 'îy ee Shortened from H188; alas!: - woe.
entries.338: אי 'îy ee Probably identical with H337 (through the idea of a doleful sound); a howler (used only in the {plural}) that {is} any solitary wild creature: - wild beast of the islands.
entries.339: אי 'îy ee From H183; properly a habitable spot (as desirable); dry {land} a {coast} an island: - {country} {isle} island.
entries.340: איב 'âyab aw-yab' A primitive root; to hate (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be hostile: - be an enemy.
entries.341: אויב איב 'ôyêb 'ôyêb {o-yabe'} o-yabe' Active participle of H340; hating; an adversary: - {enemy} foe.
entries.342: איבה 'êybâh ay-baw' From H340; hostility: - {enmity} hatred.
entries.343: איד 'êyd ade From the same as H181 (in the sense of bending down); oppression; by implication {misfortune} ruin: - {calamity} destruction.
entries.344: איּה 'ayâh ah-yaw' Perhaps from H337; the {screamer} that {is} a hawk: - {kite} vulture.
entries.345: איּה 'ayâh ah-yaw' The same as H344; {Ajah} the name of two Israelites: - {Aiah} Ajah.
entries.346: איּה 'ayêh ah-yay' Prolonged from H335; where?: - where.
entries.347: איּוב 'îyôb ee-yobe' From H340; hated (that {is} persecuted); {Ijob} the patriarch famous for his patience: - Job.
entries.348: איזבל 'îyzebel ee-zeh'-bel From H336 and H2083; {chaste} {Izebel} the wife of king Ahab: - Jezebel.
entries.349: איככה איכה איך 'êyk 'êykâh 'êykâkâh {ake} {ay-kaw'} ay-kaw'-kah Prolonged from H335; how? or how!; also where: - {how} what.
entries.350: אי־כבוד 'îy-kâbôd ee-kaw-bode' From H336 and H3519; (there is) no {glory} that {is} inglorious; {Ikabod} a son of Phineas: - I-chabod.
entries.351: איכה 'êykôh ay-ko Probably a variation for {H349} but not as an interrogative; where: - where.
entries.352: איל 'ayil ah'-yil From the same as H193; properly strength; hence anything strong; specifically a chief (politically); also a ram (from his strength); a pilaster (as a strong support); an oak or other strong tree: - mighty ({man}) {lintel} {oak} {post} {ram} tree.
entries.353: איל 'ĕyâl eh-yawl' A variation of H352; strength: - strength.
entries.354: איּל 'ayâl ah-yawl' An intensive form of H352 (in the sense of ram); a stag or male deer: - hart.
entries.355: איּלה 'ayâlâh ah-yaw-law' Feminine of H354; a doe or female deer: - hind.
entries.356: אילן אלון אילון 'êylôn 'êlôn 'êylôn {ay-lone'} {ay-lone'} ay-lone' From H352; oakgrove; {Elon} the name of a place in {Palestine} and also of one {Hittite} two Israelite: - Elon.
entries.357: איּלון 'ayâlôn ah-yaw-lone' From H354; deerfield; {Ajalon} the name of five places in Palestine: - {Aijalon} Ajalon.
entries.358: אילון בּית חנן 'êylôn bêyth chânân ay-lone' bayth-khaw-nawn' From {H356} {H1004} and H2603; oakgrove of (the) house of favor; Elon of {Bethchanan} a place in Palestine: - Elon-beth-hanan.
entries.359: אילת אילות 'êylôth 'êylath {ay-loth'} ay-lath' From H352; trees or a grove (that {is} palms); Eloth or {Elath} a place on the Red Sea: - {Elath} Eloth.
entries.360: אילוּת 'ĕyâlûth eh-yaw-looth' Feminine of H353; power; by implication protection: - strength.
entries.361: אלמּה אלם אילם 'êylâm 'êlâm 'êlammâh {ay-lawm'} {ay-lawm'} ay-lam-maw' Probably from H352; a pillar space (or {colonnade}) that {is} a pale (or portico): - arch.
entries.362: אילם 'êylim ay-leem' Plural of H352; palm trees; {Elim} a place in the Desert: - Elim.
entries.363: אילן 'îylân ee-lawn' (Chaldee); corresponding to H356; a tree: - tree.
entries.364: איל פּארן 'êyl pâ'rân ale paw-rawn' From H352 and H6290; oak of Paran; El {Paran} a portion of the district of Paran: - El-paran.
entries.365: איּלת 'ayĕlĕth ay-yeh'-leth The same as H355; a doe: - {hind} Aijeleth.
entries.366: אים 'âyôm aw-yome' From an unused root (meaning to frighten); frightful: - terrible.
entries.367: אמה אימה 'êymâh 'êmâh {ay-maw'} ay-maw' From the same as H366; fright; concretely an idol (as a bugbear): - dread. {fear} {horror} {idol} {terrible} terror.
entries.368: אימים 'êymîym ay-meem' Plural of H367; terrors; {Emim} an early Canaanitish (or Moabitish) tribe: - Emims.
entries.369: אין 'ayin ay'-yin As if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist; a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle: - {else} {except} fail [father-] {less} be {gone} in {[-curable]} {neither} {never} no ({where}) {none} nor ({any} {thing}) {not} {nothing} to {nought} {past} un {[-searchable]} {well-nigh} {without} Compare H370.
entries.370: אין 'ayin ah-yin' Probably identical with H369 in the sense of query (compare H336); where? (only in connection with prepositional {prefix} whence): - {whence} where.
entries.371: אין 'îyn een Apparently a shortened form of H369; but (like H370) interrogitive; is it not?: - not
entries.372: איעזר 'îy‛ezêr ee-eh'-zer From H336 and H5828; helpless; {Iezer} an Israelite: - Jeezer.
entries.373: איעזרי 'îy‛ezrîy ee-ez-ree' Patronymic from H372; an Iezrite or descendant of Iezer: - Jezerite.
entries.374: אפה איפה 'êyphâh 'êphâh {ay-faw'} ay-faw' Of Egyptian derivation; an ephah or measure for grain; hence a measure in general: - {ephah} (divers) measure (-s).
entries.375: איפה 'êyphôh ay-fo' From H335 and H6311; what place?; also (of time) when?; or (of means) how?: - what {manner} where.
entries.376: אישׁ 'îysh eesh Contracted for H582 (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant); a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation.) : - {also} {another} any ({man}) a {certain} + {champion} {consent} {each} every ({one}) {fellow} {[foot-} husband-] {man} ({good-} {great} mighty) {man} {he} high ({degree}) him (that {is}) {husband} man {[-kind]} + {none} {one} {people} {person} + {steward} what (man) {soever} whoso ({-ever}) worthy. Compare H802.
entries.377: אישׁ 'îysh eesh Denominative from H376; to be a {man} that {is} act in a manly way: - show (one) self a man.
entries.378: אישׁ־בּשׁת 'îysh-bôsheth eesh-bo'-sheth From H376 and H1322; man of shame; {IshBosheth} a son of King Saul: - Ish-bosheth.
entries.379: אישׁהוד 'îyshhôd eesh-hode' From H376 and H1935; man of renown; {Ishod} an Israelite: - Ishod.
entries.380: אישׁון 'îyshôn ee-shone' Diminutive from H376; the little man of the eye; the pupil or ball; hence the middle (of night): - apple [of the {eye]} {black} obscure.
entries.381: אישׁ־חי אישׁ־חיל 'îysh-chayil 'îysh-chay {eesh-khah'-yil} eesh-khah'ee From H376 and H2428; man of might; (The second form is by defective transcription used in 2Sam 23:20); as if from H376 and H2416; living man; Ishchail (or {Ishchai}) an Israelite: - a valiant man.
entries.382: אישׁ־טוב 'îysh-ţôb eesh-tobe' From H376 and H2897; man of Tob; {Ish-Tob} a place in Palestine: - Ish-tob.
entries.383: איתי 'îythay ee-thah'ee (Chaldee); corresponding to H3426; properly entity; used only as a particle of {affirmation} there is: - art {thou} {can} do {ye} have it {be} there is ({are}) X we will not.
entries.384: איתיאל 'îythîy'êl eeth-ee-ale' Perhaps from H837 and H410; God has arrived; {Ithiel} the name of an {Israelite} also of a symbolic person: - Ithiel.
entries.385: איתמר 'îythâmâr eeth-aw-mawr' From H339 and H8558; coast of the palm tree; {Ithamar} a son of Aaron: - Ithamar.
entries.386: איתן 'êythân ay-thawn' From an unused root (meaning to continue); permanence; hence (concretely) permanent; specifically a chieftain: - {hard} {mighty} {rough} {strength} strong.
entries.387: איתן 'êythân ay-thawn' The same as H386; permanent; {Ethan} the name of four Israelites: - Ethan.
entries.388: איתנים 'êythânîym ay-thaw-neem' Plural of H386; always with the article; the permanent brooks; {Ethanim} the name of a month: - Ethanim.
entries.389: אך 'ak ak Akin to H403; a particle of {affirmation} surely; hence (by limitation) only: - {also} in any {wise} at {least} {but} {certainly} {even} {howbeit} {nevertheless} {notwithstanding} {only} {save} surely of a {surety} {truly} {verily} + {wherefore} yet (but).
entries.390: אכּד 'akkad ak-kad' From an unused root probably meaning to strengthen; a fortress; {Accad} a place in Babylon: - Accad.
entries.391: אכזב 'akzâb ak-zawb' From H3576; falsehood; by implication treachery: - {liar} lie.
entries.392: אכזיב 'akzîyb ak-zeeb' From H391; deceitful (in the sense of a winter torrent which fails in summer); {Akzib} the name of two places in Palestine: - Achzib.
entries.393: אכזר 'akzâr ak-zawr' From an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly); violent; by implication deadly; also (in a good sense) brave: - {cruel} fierce.
entries.394: אכזרי 'akzârîy ak-zaw-ree' From H393; terrible: - cruel (one).
entries.395: אכזריּוּת 'akzerîyûth ak-ze-ree-ooth' From H394; fierceness: - cruel.
entries.396: אכילה 'ăkîylâh ak-ee-law' Feminine from H398; something {eatable} that {is} food: - meat.
entries.397: אכישׁ 'âkîysh aw-keesh' Of uncertain derivation; {Akish} a Philistine king: - Achish.
entries.398: אכל 'âkal aw-kal' A primitive root; to eat (literally or figuratively): - X at {all} burn {up} {consume} devour ({-er} {up}) {dine} eat ({-er} {up}) feed ({with}) {food} X {freely} X in . . . wise ({-deed} {plenty}) (lay) {meat} X quite.
entries.399: אכל 'ăkal ak-al' (Chaldee); corresponding to H398: - + {accuse} {devour} eat.
entries.400: אכל 'ôkel o'-kel From H398; food: - {eating} {food} meal {[-time]} {meat} {prey} victuals.
entries.401: אכּל אכל 'ûkâl 'ûkkâl {oo-kawl'} ook-kawl' Apparently from H398; devoured; {Ucal} a fancy name: - Ucal.
entries.402: אכלה 'ôklâh ok-law' Feminine of H401; food: - {consume} {devour} {eat} {food} meat.
entries.403: אכן 'âkên aw-kane' From H3559 (compare H3651); firmly; figuratively surely; also (adversely) but: - {but} {certainly} {nevertheless} {surely} {truly} verily.
entries.404: אכף 'âkaph aw-kaf' A primitive root; apparent meaning to curve (as with a burden); to urge: - crave.
entries.405: אכף 'ekeph eh'-kef From H404; a load; by implication a stroke (others dignity): - hand.
entries.406: אכּר 'ikkâr ik-kawr' From an unused root meaning to dig; a farmer: - {husbandman} ploughman.
entries.407: אכשׁף 'akshâph ak-shawf' From H3784; fascination; {Acshaph} a place in Palestine: - Achshaph.
entries.408: אל 'al al A negative particle (akin to H3808); not (the qualified {negation} used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a {noun} nothing: - {nay} {neither} + {never} {no} {nor} {not} nothing {[worth]} rather than.
entries.409: אל 'al al (Chaldee); corresponding to H408: - not.
entries.410: אל 'êl ale Shortened from H352; strength; as adjective mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity): - God ({god}) X {goodly} X {great} {idol} might (-y {one}) {power} strong. Compare names in "-el."
entries.411: אל 'êl ale A demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense) these or those: - {these} {those} Compare H428.
entries.412: אל 'êl ale (Chaldee); corresponding to H411: - these.
entries.413: אל אל 'êl 'el {ale} el (Used only in the shortened constructive form (the second form)); a primitive {particle} properly denoting motion {towards} but occasionally used of a quiescent {position} that {is} near6 with or among; often in {general} to: - {about} according {to} {after} {against} {among} as {for} {at} because ({-fore} {-side}) both . . . {and} {by} {concerning} {for} {from} X {hath} in ({-to}) {near} (out) {of} {over} through6to ({-ward}) {under} {unto} {upon} {whether} with(-in).
entries.414: אלא 'êlâ' ay-law' A variation of H424; oak; {Ela} an Israelite: - Elah.
entries.415: אל אלהי ישׂראל 'êl 'ĕlôhêy yiώrâ'êl ale el-o-hay' yis-raw-ale' From H410 and H430 and H3478; the mighty God of Jisrael; El Elohi {Jisrael} the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - El-elohe-israel.
entries.416: אל בּית־אל 'êl bêyth-'êl ale bayth-ale' From H410 and H1008; the God of Bethel; {El-Bethel} the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - El-beth-el.
entries.417: אלגּבישׁ 'elgâbîysh el-gaw-beesh' From H410 and H1378; hail (as if a great pearl): - great hail [-stones].
entries.418: אלגּוּמּים 'algûmmîym al-goom-meem' By transposition for H484; sticks of algum wood: - algum [trees].
entries.419: אלדּד 'eldâd el-dad' From H410 and H1780; God has loved; {Eldad} an Israelite: - Eldad.
entries.420: אלדּעה 'eldâ‛âh el-daw-aw' From H410 and H3045; God of knowledge; {Eldaah} a son of Midian: - Eldaah.
entries.421: אלה 'âlâh aw-law' A primitive root (rather identical with H422 through the idea of invocation); to bewail: - lament.
entries.422: אלה 'âlâh aw-law' A primitive root; properly to {adjure} that {is} (usually in a bad sense) imprecate: - {adjure} {curse} swear.
entries.423: אלה 'âlâh aw-law' From H422; an imprecation: - {curse} {cursing} {execration} {oath} swearing.
entries.424: אלה 'êlâh ay-law' Feminine of H352; an oak or other strong tree: - {elm} {oak} teil tree
entries.425: אלה 'êlâh ay-law' The same as H424; {Elah} the name of an {Edomite} or four {Israelites} and also of a place in Palestine: - Elah.
entries.426: אלהּ 'ĕlâhh el-aw' (Chaldee); corresponding to H433; God: - {God} god.
entries.427: אלּה 'allâh al-law' A variation of H424: - oak.
entries.428: אלּה 'êlleh ale'-leh Prolonged from H411; these or those: - an- (the) other; one {sort} {so} {some} {such} {them} these ({same}) {they} {this} {those} {thus} {which} who (-m).
entries.429: אלּה 'êlleh ale'-leh (Chaldee); corresponding to H428: - these.
entries.430: אלהים 'ĕlôhîym el-o-heem' Plural of H433; gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural {thus} especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative: - {angels} X {exceeding} God (gods) ({-dess} {-ly}) X (very) {great} {judges} X mighty.
entries.431: אלוּ 'ălû al-oo' (Chaldee); probably prolonged from H412; lo!: - behold.
entries.432: אלּוּ 'illû il-loo' Probably from H408; {nay} that {is} (softened) if: - but {if} yea though.
entries.433: אלהּ אלוהּ 'ĕlôahh 'ĕlôahh {el-o'-ah} el-o'-ah (The second form is rare); probably prolonged (emphatically) from H410; a deity or the deity: - {God} god. See H430.
entries.434: אלוּל 'ĕlûl el-ool' For H457; good for nothing: - thing of nought.
entries.435: אלוּל 'ĕlûl el-ool' Probably of foreign derivation; {Elul} the sixth Jewish month: - Elul.
entries.436: אלון 'êlôn ay-lone' Prolonged from H352; an oak or other strong tree: - plain. See also H356.

entries.803: אשׁוּיה 'ăshûyâh ash-oo-yah' Feminine passive participle from an unused root meaning to found; foundation: - foundation.

entries.833: אשׁר אשׁר 'âshar 'âshêr {aw-shar'} aw-share' A primitive root; to be straight (used in the widest {sense} especially to be {level} right6 happy); figuratively to go {forward} be {honest} prosper: - ({call} be) bless ({-ed} {happy}) {go} {guide} {lead} relieve.
entries.834: אשׁר 'ăsher ash-er' A primitive relative pronoun (of every gender and number); {who} which6 {what} that; also (as adverb and conjunction) {when} where6 {how} because6 in order {that} etc.: - X {after} X {alike} as (soon {as}) {because} X {every} {for} + {forasmuch} + from {whence} + how ({-soever}) X {if} (so) that ([thing] {which} {wherein}) X {though} + {until} + {whatsoever} {when} where (+ {-as} {-in} {-of} {-on} {-soever} {-with}) {which} {whilst} + whither ({-soever}) who ({-m} {-soever} -se). entries.836: אשׁר 'âshêr aw-share' From H833; happy; {Asher} a son of {Jacob} and the tribe descended from {him} with its territory; also a place in Palestine: - Asher.
entries.837: אשׁר 'ôsher o'-sher From H833; happiness: - happy.

entries.862: אתּיק אתּוּק 'attûq 'attîyq {at-tooke'} at-teek' From H5423 in the sense of decreasing; a ledge or offset in a building: - gallery.

entries.8634: תּראלה tar'ălâh tar-al-aw' Probably for H8653; a reeling; {Taralah} a place in Palestine: - Taralah.
entries.8635: תּרבּוּת tarbûth tar-booth' From H7235; {multiplication} that {is} progeny: - increase.
entries.8636: תּרבּית tarbîyth tar-beeth' From H7235; {multiplication} that {is} percentage or bonus in addition to principal: - {increase} unjust gain.
entries.8637: תּרגּל tirgal teer-gal' A denominative from H7270; to cause to walk: - teach to go.
entries.8638: תּרגּם tirgam teer-gam' A denominative from H7275 in the sense of throwing over; to {transfer} that {is} translate: - interpret.
entries.8639: תּרדּמה tardêmâh tar-day-maw' From H7290; a lethargy or (by implication) trance: - deep sleep.
entries.8640: תּרהקה tirhâqâh teer-haw'-kaw Of foreign derivation; {Tirhakah} a king of Kush: - Tirhakah.
entries.8641: תּרמה תּרוּמה terûmâh terûmâh {ter-oo-maw'} ter-oo-maw' (The second form used in Deut 12:11); from H7311; a present (as offered {up}) especially in sacrifice or as tribute: - {gift} heave offering ({[shoulder]}) {oblation} offered (-ing).
entries.8642: תּרוּמיּה terûmîyâh ter-oo-mee-yaw' Formed as H8641; a sacrificial offering: - oblation.
entries.8643: תּרוּעה terû‛âh ter-oo-aw' From H7321; {clamor} that {is} acclamation of joy or a battle cry; especially clangor of {trumpets} as an alarum: - {alarm} blow (-ing) ({of} the) ({trumpets}) {joy} {jubile} loud {noise} {rejoicing} shout ({-ing}) ({high} joyful) sound (-ing).
entries.8644: תּרוּפה terûphâh ter-oo-faw' From H7322 in the sense of its congener H7495; a remedy: - medicine.
entries.8645: תּרזה tirzâh teer-zaw' Probably from H7329; a species of tree (apparently from its {slenderness}) perhaps the cypress: - cypress.
entries.8646: תּרח terach teh'-rakh Of uncertain derivation; {Terach} the father of Abraham; also a place in the Desert: - {Tarah} Terah.
entries.8647: תּרחנה tirchănâh teer-khan-aw' Of uncertain derivation; {Tirchanah} an Israelite: - Tirhanah.
entries.8648: תּרתּין תּרין terêyn tartêyn {ter-ane'} tar-tane' {(Chaldee}) the secend form is feminine; corresponding to H8147; two: - {second} + {twelve} two.
entries.8649: תּרמית תּרמוּת תּרמהo tormâh tarmûth tarmîyth {tor-maw'} {tar-mooth'} tar-meeth' From H7411; fraud: - deceit ({-ful}) privily.
entries.8650: תּרן tôren to'-ren Probably for H766; a pole (as a mast or flag staff): - {beacon} mast.
entries.8651: תּרע tera‛ ter-ah' {(Chaldee}) corresponding to H8179; a door; by implication a palace: - gate mouth.
entries.8652: תּרע târâ‛ taw-raw' {(Chaldee}) from H8651; a doorkeeper: - porter.
entries.8653: תּרעלה tar‛êlâh tar-ay-law' From H7477; reeling: - {astonishment} trembling.
entries.8654: תּרעתי tir‛âthîy teer-aw-thee' Patrial from an unused name meaning gate; a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah: - Tirathite.
entries.8655: תּרפים terâphîym ter-aw-feme' Plural perhaps from H7495; a healer; Teraphim (singular or plural) a family idol: - idols ({-atry}) {images} teraphim.
entries.8656: תּרצה tirtsâh teer-tsaw' From H7521; delightsomeness; {Tirtsah} a place in Palestine; also an Israelitess: - also an Israelitess: - Tirzah.
entries.8657: תּרשׁ teresh teh'-resh Of foreign derivation; {Teresh} a eunuch of Xerxes: - Teresh.
entries.8658: תּרשׁישׁ tarshîysh tar-sheesh' Probably of foreign derivation (compare H8659); a {gem} perhaps the topaz: - beryl.
entries.8659: תּרשׁישׁ tarshîysh tar-sheesh' Probably the same as H8658 (as the region of the {stone} or the reverse); {Tarshish} a place on the {Mediterranean} hence the epithet of a merchant vessel (as if for or from that port); also the name of a Persian and of an Israelite: - {Tarshish} Tharshish.
entries.8660: תּרשׁתא tirshâthâ' teer-shaw-thaw' Of foreign derivation; the title of a Persian deputy or governor: - Tirshatha.
entries.8661: תּרתּן tartân tar-tawn' Of foreign derivation; {Tartan} an Assyrian: - Tartan.
entries.8662: תּרתּק tartâq tar-tawk' Of foreign derivation; {Tartak} a deity of the Avvites: - Tartak.
entries.8663: תּשׁאה teshû'âh tesh-oo-aw' From H7722; a crashing or loud clamor: - {crying} {noise} {shouting} stir.
entries.8664: תּשׁבּי tishbîy tish-bee' Patrial from an unused name meaning recourse; a Tishbite or inhabitant of Tishbeh (in Gilead): - Tishbite.
entries.8665: תּשׁבּץ tashbêts tash-bates' From H7660; checkered stuff (as reticulated): - broidered.
entries.8666: תּשׁבה תּשׁוּבה teshûbâh teshûbâh {tesh-oo-baw'} tesh-oo-baw' From H7725; a recurrence (of time or place); a reply (as returned): - {answer} be {expired} return.
entries.8667: תּשׂוּמת teώûmeth tes-oo-meth' From H7760; a {deposit} that {is} pledging: - + fellowship.
entries.8668: תּשׁעה תּשׁוּעה teshû‛âh teshû‛âh {tesh-oo-aw'} tesh-oo-aw' From H7768 in the sense of H3467; rescue (literally or {figuratively} {personal} national or spiritual): - {deliverance} {help} {safety} {salvation} victory.
entries.8669: תּשׁוּקה teshûqâh tesh-oo-kaw' From H7783 in the original sense of stretching out after; a longing: - desire.
entries.8670: תּשׁוּרה teshûrâh tesh-oo-raw' From H7788 in the sense of arrival; a gift: - present.
entries.8671: תּשׁיעי teshîy‛îy tesh-ee-ee' Ordinal from H8672; ninth: - ninth.
entries.8672: תּשׁעה תּשׁע têsha‛ tish‛âh {tay'-shah} tish-aw' The second form is the masculine of the first; perhaps from H8159 through the idea of a turn to the next or full number ten; nine or (ordinal) ninth: - nine (+ {-teen} + {-teenth} -th).
entries.8673: תּשׁעים tish‛îym tish-eem' Multiple from H8672; ninety: - ninety.
entries.8674: תּתּני tattenay tat-ten-ah'ee Of foreign derivation; {Tattenai} a Persian: - Tatnai.
